scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w @quoteflow/shared" "npm run dev -w @quoteflow/api" "npm run dev -w @quoteflow/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @quoteflow/api && npm run build -w @quoteflow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:shared && npm run test:e2e -w @quoteflow/api
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run check:i18n && npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:shared && npm run seed -w @quoteflow/api
scripts.db:seed:demo: npm run build:shared && npm run seed:demo -w @quoteflow/api
